author: pep-react-lab-replacement author lane (Claude Opus 5.5)
decidedBy: pep-react-lab-replacement-reconciler loop 6 (Claude Opus 5.5, fresh independent context; neither the lab author, either critic, nor any earlier reconciler), applying firstmate decision react-forms-loop5-polish (2026-11-18)

decisions.rationale: Reconciler-reproduced on macOS (darwin), Node 24.2.0 and npm 11.3.0, in a 0700 scratch copy made with git archive of 70199b59 (70199b59ef11bb532817b7e09630bdf8e33cd182), with the private overlay copied over the starter, npm ci in tests/, and the overlay's reference learner test unless stated otherwise. Claim verified true. Learner-side: the reconciler wrote its own correct learner test that, at module level, throws only when the imported default export is the Task 8 variant wrapper. The normal run showed 'Test Files 8 passed (8)' and 'Tests 8 passed (8)', then npm test printed only 'Task 8: no runnable test was found in starter/src/service-form.test.jsx. The file may be missing or empty, or hold only todo or skipped tests. ...' and exited 1. Running the control variant directly gave exit 1 and a JSON report with numTotalTestSuites 1, numFailedTestSuites 1, numTotalTests 0, and one test file with status failed, no assertion results and the thrown message. With the c68e4995 verifier swapped into scratch, the same file got the unchanged-copy message. Harness-side: with a module-level throw appended to a scratch copy of tests/task8-variant.jsx (restored afterwards; sha256 d85eae98... rechecked), the reference test got the same no-runnable message with exit 1. A deleted learner file instead gives a report with no test files, so the two cases can be told apart from the report. Cause, confirmed from the code: line 68 tests only assertion results, and a file that fails to load has none, so 'no failed and no passed assertion' is true. Severity: low, agreed. The verdict stays exit 1, no weak test can be accepted this way, and only the diagnosis is wrong. A correct learner following the README does not write a test that fails to load only under the check, so the realistic trigger is a harness or plugin load failure on a platform never run (Windows and Linux are unverified). Consolidated with sme-fcc-w1; this record carries the shared reproduction and fix. Scope verdict: the one-condition narrowing is within the scope of Firstmate decision react-forms-loop5-polish item (a), and it does not need a new Firstmate decision on substance. It changes only tests/verify-learner-test.mjs, the file that decision names. It repairs a regression that the item (a) change itself introduced, so that (a) becomes accurate without making the load-failure message less accurate than it was at c68e4995. It narrows the new branch back rather than adding harness behaviour, and it does not touch form recognition, button scoping, the README, source or import handling. It is, however, a further byte change after 70199b59 was implemented and rechecked, and earlier reconcilers treated every lab byte change as needing Firstmate. Firstmate decides authority, so the reconciler asks Firstmate to confirm it as follow-through under react-forms-loop5-polish before the author edits. Printing the failed suite's error text (the critics' 'ideally' option) is new harness behaviour and is outside that scope; it needs a new Firstmate decision and is not recommended for v1. Smallest fix direction (one consolidated fix for edu-fcc-w1 and sme-fcc-w1, in tests/verify-learner-test.mjs only): have runVariant also report whether any test file in the JSON report has status failed, and take the no-runnable branch only when no test file failed, no assertion failed and none passed. Leave every message and every other branch unchanged. Add a module-level load error to the private adversarial controls. Trial: the reconciler applied exactly that narrowing to a scratch copy of the verifier. Results with the trial verifier: the learner-side load error and the harness-side load error both got the unchanged-copy message with exit 1 (matching c68e4995 for this case). The deleted file, a todo-only file and a skip-only file kept the no-runnable message with exit 1. A learner test with an extra test that loads but throws only under the mutation config got the unchanged-copy message with exit 1, as at 70199b59. The reconciler's blank-only weak test got the same four completed-submission messages as at 70199b59, exit 1. The outside-caption form kept the reworded fail-closed message, exit 1. The reference test was still accepted with the Task 8 line and exit 0. Residual, not introduced by 70199b59: for a harness-side load failure, the restored unchanged-copy message is still not accurate, because the learner's test does not depend on anything other than the form. That was the c68e4995 behaviour too. Only printing the suite error, which needs a new decision, would make it accurate. Consequence: any w1 fix changes the verifier's sha256 (now 7b3e2668...). The loop-6 recheck bindings to that file, the fixedIn evidence for sme-fcc-u5, edu-fcc-v2 and sme-fcc-v2, and the solved-run record would then need re-recording and a targeted recheck at the new commit.

Status changed in loop 6: the loop-6 SME recheck marks it resolved. The loop-4 records (coding-lab-loop4-reconciliation.json and coding-lab-loop4-decision-reconciliation.json) record this finding as accept under react-forms-loop4-correction; the loop-5 reconciliation described that decision as escalate and found the loop-4 fix incomplete. Decided: Firstmate decision react-forms-loop5-polish (2026-11-18) item (a) authorized changing only tests/verify-learner-test.mjs so that a missing or deleted learner test file reports an accurate no-runnable message. Implemented at commit 70199b59; the verifier's sha256 is now 7b3e2668f4d95ce30f2317c2a074f0a2382f6471666a4881d9ec7b8cf2a92c44. Reconciler-reproduced on macOS (darwin), Node 24.2.0 and npm 11.3.0, in a 0700 scratch copy made with git archive of 70199b59 (70199b59ef11bb532817b7e09630bdf8e33cd182), with the private overlay copied over the starter, npm ci in tests/, and the overlay's reference learner test unless stated otherwise. With starter/src/service-form.test.jsx deleted, the normal run showed 'Test Files 7 passed (7)' and 'Tests 7 passed (7)', then npm test printed only the no-runnable message (the file may be missing or empty, or hold only todo or skipped tests) and exited 1. The unchanged-copy message no longer appears for the deleted file. A todo-only file and a skip-only file got the same message with exit 1. The reference test was still accepted with the Task 8 line and exit 0. The deleted-file case is resolved. The same change introduced edu-fcc-w1 / sme-fcc-w1 (a file that fails to load under the check now also gets this message); that is decided separately and does not reopen this finding. If the w1 narrowing is applied, the reconciler's trial shows the deleted-file, todo-only and skip-only messages are kept.

Status changed in loop 6: the loop-6 education recheck marks it resolved. Loop 5 escalated it. Decided: Firstmate decision react-forms-loop5-polish (2026-11-18) item (b) authorized only a general learner-safe wording for the unreadable-form message in tests/verify-learner-test.mjs, and deliberately not the label-query change in tests/task8-variant.jsx. Implemented at commit 70199b59; the verifier's sha256 is now 7b3e2668f4d95ce30f2317c2a074f0a2382f6471666a4881d9ec7b8cf2a92c44, and task8-variant.jsx is unchanged (sha256 d85eae98...). Reconciler-reproduced on macOS (darwin), Node 24.2.0 and npm 11.3.0, in a 0700 scratch copy made with git archive of 70199b59 (70199b59ef11bb532817b7e09630bdf8e33cd182), with the private overlay copied over the starter, npm ci in tests/, and the overlay's reference learner test unless stated otherwise. The reconciler removed the solved form's name label in scratch and labelled the name input with aria-labelledby, pointing at a 'Service name' caption rendered just outside the form element. The normal run showed 'Tests 8 passed (8)', then npm test printed only the reworded message: the check could not find the 'Service name' and 'Owning team' fields by their labels inside the form your test submitted, and the learner should keep the text that labels each field inside the <form> element. Exit 1. It no longer sends the learner back to tasks 1-2. With the same caption moved inside the form, the run was accepted with the Task 8 line and exit 0, so the advice is accurate and actionable for the known trigger. The message names only labels and the form element and reveals no solution code. The message-only remainder is resolved. By decision, the fail-closed behaviour for a correct form whose caption is outside the form stays: such a form is still not accepted (see sme-fcc-v2). The education critic's wording nit (both fields named even when one is missing; 'Keep') is not a finding and needs no change.

Status changed in loop 6: the loop-6 SME recheck marks it resolved for its message part. Consolidated with edu-fcc-v2, which carries the reconciler's reproduction at 70199b59. Loop 5 escalated it. Decided: Firstmate decision react-forms-loop5-polish (2026-11-18) item (b) authorized only the message rewording in tests/verify-learner-test.mjs (now sha256 7b3e2668f4d95ce30f2317c2a074f0a2382f6471666a4881d9ec7b8cf2a92c44), not the label-query change in tests/task8-variant.jsx, which is unchanged (sha256 d85eae98...). The wrong-advice part of the claim is resolved: the outside-caption form now gets the accurate fail-closed message with exit 1, and moving the caption inside the form is accepted with exit 0 (reconciler-observed). Remaining by decision, not open: a correct form whose aria-labelledby caption sits outside the form element still fails closed instead of being accepted, because the variant's label query is still scoped to the submitted form. The verdict for weak tests is unchanged; the SME's blank-only run on that form (message plus the three completed-submission misses) is critic-reported, not rerun. The cited Testing Library container behaviour is consistent with the observed results and was not re-fetched. If Firstmate later reopens this, the loop-5 fix direction (query labels from the document body and keep only matches inside the submitted form) still applies.
